smells.finding: finish_work's body (:1023-1105, ~83 lines including the closing docstring quote) implements 8 fixed, sequential, load-bearing steps (verify -> release children -> top-level release -> reap -> archive -> push -> optional PR) -- roughly a third of those lines are inline comments restating why each step's position is non-negotiable, not executable logic. This is the exact same judgment g2-review made for _release_child_plans (~55 lines, marked absent as 'proportionate to implementing three documented safety properties as one cohesive unit'): the handoff states the ORDER is 'the whole point of both cold critiques' (PLAN_CRITIQUE.md finding 1/2, PLAN_CRITIC.md findings 1-3) -- splitting the steps into separate helper functions would hide that order across call sites instead of keeping it auditable in one place, working against the property this function exists to guarantee.
No classes added; two new module-level functions (finish_work, open_pr) plus a CLI module (spine_done_cli.py) that is argument-parsing plus one call, ~50 lines of actual logic.

The three refusal-return dicts ({"ok": False, "refusal": ..., "stage": ...} at steps 2/4/6) share a shape but not a copy-pasted block -- each is a single 3-key literal built from a different upstream value (a plain string, a nested dict's own field, a caught exception's str()), and each names a different 'stage'. No block of >2 lines repeats verbatim elsewhere in the diff. spine_done_cli.py's git-status-porcelain auto-detect (_auto_tree_clean) has no duplicate elsewhere in the codebase (grepped: the only other 'git status --porcelain' hit is a docstring comment in checklist_engine.py, not a second implementation).

finish_work calls only the public functions of its own module (done_refusal, _release_child_plans, _advance_and_release, force_reap, close_work, open_pr) by their documented contracts -- it never reaches into their internals or into checklist_engine's/spine_rail's internals directly. This is the composition the function exists to perform, not envy.

No group of primitives is passed around together as an informal substitute for an object; spine_path/root/session_id/today/tree_clean/episodes_captured are each independently meaningful and independently required by the specific downstream primitive that consumes them (done_refusal takes exactly tree_clean+episodes_captured; _advance_and_release takes exactly spine_path+session_id+root+why).

finish_work returns a plain dict on both the success and refusal paths ({"ok": True, "work_id": ..., ...} / {"ok": False, "refusal": ..., "stage": ...}) rather than a typed result (dataclass/NamedTuple); open_pr returns a bare str | None.
